name: io.github.Cygnux-Labs/tracekit-mcp-gateway
title: Tracekit MCP gateway
description: MCP gateway you deploy: a Tracekit signer decides and signs each call; agents send each run's token.

tracekit_gateway.description: host:port of the gateway you deployed (tracekit mcp-gateway serve, as its own user, with TLS)

headers.name: X-Tracekit-Run
headers.description: <run_id>.<run_token> of the agent's run (register_run): new for every run, so the agent framework sets it per run; one typed in once works for one run

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token>: the agent's identity, when the gateway's http.authenticators accept a bearer or Kubernetes service account token (else a client certificate)
